aboutGame.title: What is The Loopler?
paragraphs: The Loopler is an innovative roguelite arcade loop builder where players design tracks, draft dynamic cards, and place multiplier gates to maximize vehicle runs. Race through endless circular pathways, trigger massive score combos, and collect unique charms to fuel your progression.

Whether you are fine-tuning gate placements, experimenting with deck synergies, or unlocking specialized cars and tracks, The Loopler Wiki provides comprehensive guides, strategy breakdowns, and patch notes to help you dominate every loop.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to common gameplay and progression questions about The Loopler.

items.question: What is The Loopler?
items.answer: The Loopler is a roguelite arcade loop builder on Steam where players draft cards, place multiplier gates, and collect charms to create endless scoring pathways for high-speed vehicles.

items.question: How do beginner players progress in The Loopler?
items.answer: In The Loopler, new players should focus on establishing clean track loops, drafting complementary cards early, and chaining multiplier gates before investing in expensive high-tier upgrades.

items.question: What are the most effective builds in The Loopler?
items.answer: Top builds in The Loopler combine velocity-boosting cards with compound multiplier gates and passive charms like Quantum Core to create exponential score loops.

items.question: Where can I find the latest updates and patches for The Loopler?
items.answer: You can track development updates, patch notes, and demo announcements for The Loopler directly through our Updates guide and the official Steam community hub.

items.question: Does The Loopler feature Steam achievements?
items.answer: Yes, The Loopler includes Steam achievements and progression milestones that reward players for reaching high multiplier scores, discovering rare charms, and completing extended runs.
